operation.name: GetBomaLookupByName
operation.query: select intBomasid as BomaID, BomaName, BomaCode , intPayamid as PayamID from tm_Bomas where BomaName = @BomaName

operation.name: GetBomaLookupByID

operation.name: GetBomasLookup
